ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio of approximately 0.05:1 (high-intensity white to low-intensity black/grey pixels).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface consists of a near-uniform dark grey to black field. No large-scale contiguous white geometric blobs are present; high-intensity pixels are restricted to localized discrete points and distal tip clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 70 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, irregular serrations along the primary span; high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged protrusions localized at the distal tips caused by biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curve fitting a non-linear arc from the lateral tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, high-contrast circular white rings (rosettes) distributed across the dark field; dense, irregular high-intensity white clusters (barnacles) on the far lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent diagonal white linear disruption on the inner left lobe; smaller vertical linear marks visible near the right side of the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both lobes, creating a secondary textured topography protruding from the natural fluke edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several ring-shaped 'target' scars characterized by high-intensity circumferences and dark interiors.
